title: Unstable
description: A vanilla like server where everything is unstable.
body:
# Unstable
A vanilla based server with unstable players where trusting means gambling.\
Anyone will betray at any time. If you think you can survive in this server, join now!
## Features
- **Vanilla-based survival**
- **No Pay-To-Win**\
  Only Discord boosting cosmetics to flex :>
- **Unstable community**\
  Could be a rival, could be an ally, you won't know until it happens
- **4000x4000 world border**
